newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela April car sales surge 192 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela April car sales surge 192 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Vehicle sales in Venezuela rose 192 percent in April to reach 11,980 units, compared to 4,098 over the same period a year ago, Venezuela's Automobile Chamber (Cavenez) said.
The increase marks the fifth consecutive monthly year-on-year rise, with sales also up 33 percent from March's level of 9,000 cars, the chamber added.

Taking the year as a whole 1997 has seen a 122 percent rise in sales to 35,215 vehicles from 15,877 in 1996. Of these 29,875 were locally manufactured or assembled, up 111 percent from the year before, while the number of imported car sales rose to 5,340 compared to 1,748 in 1996.
Foreign exchange controls were dropped in April 1996 as part of a wider IMF-supported economic reform program.
